ownerObservations.description: The front paws are not visibly separated.
The animated creature is visibly above the ground.
Inherited movement deforms the creature unnaturally.

frontPawPlacement.cause: Paw bone landmarks were normalized from whole-model bounds instead of fitted to the two source contact clusters.

levitation.cause: Inherited c_wolf root position controllers replace an incompatible zero-height owned rootdummy bind during animation.

artificialMotion.currentWeighting: coarse normalized anatomical boxes with one primary and one torso influence
artificialMotion.cause: Leg volumes capture portions of chest and long fur, while joint locations are not fitted to source surface landmarks.

minimalIntendedRemediation: Fit left and right paw and leg-chain landmarks to source-surface contact clusters.
Derive the owned rootdummy bind from the source length and height so its neutral frame matches the inherited c_wolf root-motion frame without copying retail bind transforms.
Replace box-classified weights with distance-to-chain weights plus torso and long-fur guards.
Preserve the exact Meshy GLB, texture, c_wolf topology, Creature Basis V3 mapping and all 60780 triangles.
